intro: The Fairfax District runs from the Original Farmers Market and The Grove up Fairfax Avenue, LA's classic deli and streetwear strip, to Melrose. It's walkable, busy at all hours and home to some of the city's most famous food stalls.

inf: The Infatuation: Best restaurants in Beverly Grove
tocof: Time Out: Best coffee shops in West Hollywood
gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)

places.w: A competition-level specialty roaster with single-origin pour-overs and tasting flights.
places.o: A fruity pour-over or the espresso and cortado flight.

places.w: A calm Melrose cafe with plenty of seating and outlets, good for getting work done.
places.o: A cream-top latte and a croissant.

places.w: LA's historic open-air market of food stalls and grocers, open since 1934.
places.o: Graze: laksa, Brazilian barbecue, oysters and a pie.

places.w: A Farmers Market stall for Singaporean and Indonesian dishes.
places.o: Laksa, beef rendang and roti paratha.

places.w: A French bistro and gourmet market inside the Farmers Market.
places.o: Oysters, steak frites or quiche lorraine.

places.w: A pay-by-weight Brazilian buffet with weekend lines.
places.o: Grilled meats and the catfish moqueca.

places.w: A tiny Farmers Market counter for very good hand-pulled noodles.
places.o: Whatever noodles are being pulled that day.

places.w: An outdoor shopping village with a trolley, a fountain show and a movie theater, next to the Farmers Market.
places.o: Shop, catch a movie, then eat at the market.
Sea urchin linguine and the veal shank agnolotti.

places.w: A huge, festive Mexican landmark where the margaritas are the main event.
places.o: A house margarita with a big group.

places.w: The classic Fairfax deli, open late with great people-watching.
places.o: Pastrami on rye and a black and white cookie.

places.w: A kitschy Chinese-American spot made for groups, with a small music room.
places.o: Kung pao shrimp and lo mein.
Chicken tikka poutine and chili cheese naan.

places.w: The original all-day Italian American spot from the Animal team.
places.o: The breakfast BLT, meatballs or spicy fusilli.
Wagyu patties and the Cuban-spiced strip with fufu.

places.w: A dim, no-menu cocktail bar where the bartenders build a drink around your taste.
places.o: Tell them a spirit and a flavor you like.

places.w: A moody speakeasy across from The Grove with elaborate cocktails.
places.o: A cocktail from the spirits menu.

places.w: A big, shady park next to The Grove with lawns, walking paths and sports facilities.
places.o: A sunset walk, then dinner at the Farmers Market.
